Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely anchored the answer to the signing date of the Lateran Treaty (11 February 1929) as the moment Vatican City “became its own country,” without addressing the legal nuance that the treaty only became effective upon ratification (7 June 1929). This misclassification of the key event led to repeated, redundant searches and a failure to synthesize the evidence (including Britannica noting the treaty’s effective date), resulting in an incorrect or incomplete conclusion.
